caption: A 16-block disk: bits 0, 1 and 2 are 0 (used), so the first-fit scan stops at the first 1, block 3. Exactly nine bits are 1, so nine blocks are free.

spec.title: Bitmap: 1 = free, free count = 9
spec.aria: A 16-bit bitmap for blocks 0 to 15 of a 16-block disk, where 1 means free; blocks 0, 1 and 2 hold 0, the first 1 is at block 3, and nine bits are 1 in total.
